decisions.reason: As a newly launched core operator product with its own dedicated page, it is likely part of the firm's planned long-term garage door portfolio.
The solid wood sectional garage door is more niche, but it still fits the firm's door offering and is unlikely to be withdrawn so soon after launch.
Although it overlaps with the broader operator range, a remote-control variant is a commercially sensible feature product and would usually be retained at this stage.
